**In brief.**
388 flood-related 311 complaints were filed in Community District BX01 (by the record's community board field) in the last 3 years, by 311 descriptor group: 196 sewer backup, 112 catch basin, 53 street flooding, 27 manhole overflow (a count of reports; a low count can mean under-reporting, not the absence of flooding) [nyc311_nta]. 6.0% of this area is in a rainfall flooding category of the city's modelled stormwater scenario "Extreme Flood (3.66 inches/hr) with 2080 Sea Level Rise" and 2.1% is in its future high tide category, 1.4% of this area is in a rainfall flooding category of the city's modelled stormwater scenario "Moderate Flood (2.13 inches/hr) with 2050 Sea Level Rise" and 0.3% is in its future high tide category [dep_extreme_2080_nta][dep_moderate_2050_nta]. 14.1% of this area lies inside the 2012 Sandy inundation extent [sandy_nta].

On the city's stormwater flood map "Moderate Flood (2.13 inches/hr) with 2050 Sea Level Rise", 1.4% of this area is in a rainfall flooding category: 1.0% in "Nuisance Flooding (greater or equal to 4 in. and less than 1 ft.)" and 0.4% in "Deep and Contiguous Flooding (1 ft. and greater)"; 0.3% is in its "Future High Tides 2050" category, which is coastal tidal inundation projected for 2050 [dep_moderate_2050_nta]. On the city's stormwater flood map "Moderate Flood (2.13 inches/hr) with Current Sea Levels" (the near term), 1.2% of this area is in a rainfall flooding category: 0.8% in "Nuisance Flooding (greater or equal to 4 in. and less than 1 ft.)" and 0.4% in "Deep and Contiguous Flooding (1 ft. and greater)" [dep_moderate_current_nta].
